class.name: MVSurfaceLibrary
class.brief_description: The set of surfaces a vehicle knows about.
class.description: Maps node group names to [MVSurface] resources. [method find_surface] searches [member surfaces] in order, then falls back to [member default_surface], and finally to a shared built-in surface with the default (road) values, so it never returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: find_surface
method.description: Returns the first surface in [member surfaces] whose [member MVSurface.name] equals [param name], otherwise [member default_surface], otherwise a shared built-in road surface.

members.member: Returned by [method find_surface] when no surface matches. When empty, a shared built-in [MVSurface] with default values is used instead.
Surfaces searched in order by [method find_surface].
